explication: json-render is a guardrailed generative-UI framework and documentation playground. A developer defines a catalog and an application requests a UI from a prompt; the web API builds catalog-constrained prompts, streams model output, and the playground progressively renders the resulting spec. Core schemas, validation, state, actions, and directives support predictable runtime behavior, while framework adapters render the same model across platforms. The tree and sampled files confirm the web generation, docs, MCP, and several adapters; some listed README integrations are represented only at their documented package paths.
